create_Box_instance: create a Box instance with a custom shader name for OpenGL 3D rendering
initialize_opengl_resources: initialize OpenGL vertex arrays, buffers, and attribute pointers for the Box mesh
rebuffer_vertex_data: rebuffer updated vertex data into the OpenGL VBO after modifying Box points
draw_Box: draw the Box using its shader and world transform matrix via OpenGL
set_Box_material: set the Box material properties including ambient, diffuse, specular, and shininess values
